reviewer: Existing independent quality_review agent; read-only actual image and artifact review

design-intent.reason: 角色、服裝與髮型保留且加入獨立劍；臉部線條模糊，圓柱護手與簡略劍材質未與角色細節一致。

silhouette.reason: 人物武器輪廓清楚；後衣仍鐘形，蹲姿側衣硬折角；過頭手劍聚集臉前，未證明完整舉劍範圍。

form-proportion.reason: 實際姿勢有腕部扭折、掌面與拇指根部塌折，肩甲／上臂甲被拉成軟質折面；相對靜態baseline的3是結構退步。

materials.reason: 布、皮、金屬分區保留；臉眼、髮束與甲邊貼圖瑕疵、斑駁高光及簡略新劍材質仍在。

craft.reason: 手部長刺、靴腿大幅拉伸及深蹲前襟已有改善；腕掌、甲片接合和握持未過，原8條非流形邊未修。

use-readability.reason: 骨架與壓力姿勢是工程進展；指定連段、銜接、重心／支撐與必要效果未製作，不能提高連段用途分數。

hard_findings: Overhead grip close views show palm/thumb-base angular collapse and incomplete grasp; left finger1 minimum about19.0mm, finger3 about13.6mm from actual grip.
Downslash wrist/palm unnatural and fingers open; back close view is occluded and cannot prove rear grip.
Shoulder and layered upper-arm armor deform into soft folds; normalized weights are not hard-plate preservation.
Tabard swing improves deep crouch, but side cloth angular folds and rear waist depressions remain.
Eight source nonmanifold edges remain; full300frames and VFX absent.
limits: Fresh import is rest pose of a static rig export; it neither proves pose/animation roundtrip nor indicates a lost animation. Standing/half-crouch extra close views were not reviewed. No new Blender run, edits, secrets, network or paid action by reviewer.
